description: Today, Oregon Fourth Congressional District Candidate Monique DeSpain slammed incumbent Congresswoman Val Hoyle for supporting the disastrous Biden Open Border Policies with her vote against House Resolution 957, a resolution condemning the crisis at the southwest border and urging President Biden to end his open border policies.
